answer: Require every new identity to complete a voyage across a random route of checkpoints before it can earn: each leg ends at a ridge station or a karst cave run by a different independent operator, which stamps a time-locked receipt proving the agent was present and did real work there. A single operator running ten fakes must pay ten separate voyages, ten sets of checkpoint fees, and ten times the wall-clock time, because receipts are bound to one identity and cannot be copied between them. Honest agents pay one voyage once; a sybil farm pays per fake, every epoch, forever.
